name: Keras load_model / Lambda layer from untrusted source
attack_scenario: An attacker ships a .keras model containing a Lambda layer with marshalled code; keras.models.load_model runs it during graph reconstruction, before inference.
negative_test_hint: load a model file whose Lambda layer contains "lambda x: __import__('os').system('id')" and assert load_model refuses it or the payload never executes

exemplar.explanation: A Keras .h5/.keras file can embed Lambda layers whose Python bytecode is deserialized and run on load_model; a poisoned model file executes code. Rebuild the architecture in code and load only weights, or use safe_mode.
